title: Spicy Korean Collard Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful soup that combines the best of Korean and Southern cuisines. Spicy Korean chili flakes, briny noodles, and collard greens come together in a comforting bowl.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add Korean chili flakes and cook for an additional minute.
Add Briny Noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add Water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the noodles are fully cooked.
Add Mandu to the pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add chopped Collard Greens to the pot and cook until wilted.
Season with Soy Sauce and Salt to taste.
